items.name: Rocky road
items.description: A chocolate bar with marshmallows and pieces of biscuit inside. It is not baked and usually cut into squares.

items.name: Millionaire's shortbread
items.description: Three layers: a buttery biscuit base, soft caramel in the middle and chocolate on top. Sometimes called caramel shortbread.

items.name: Scone (with jam and cream)
items.description: A small, round cake. It is cut in half and served with jam and cream. Scones are a part of a traditional 'cream tea'.

items.name: Muffin
items.description: A soft cake in a paper case, made for one person. It may contain chocolate chips, blueberries, lemon or other flavourings.

items.name: Flapjack
items.description: A chewy bar made from oats, butter, sugar and golden syrup. It is cut into squares.

items.name: Chocolate brownie
items.description: A rich chocolate cake cut into squares. It is soft and sticky in the middle.

items.name: Chocolate chip cookie
items.description: A round, flat biscuit with pieces of chocolate inside. It can be soft or crunchy.

items.name: Cupcake
items.description: A small sponge cake in a paper case with icing on top.

items.name: Victoria sandwich
items.description: Two layers of light sponge cake with jam and cream in the middle and a little sugar on top. Also called a Victoria sponge.

items.name: Lemon drizzle cake
items.description: A lemon sponge cake with sweet lemon syrup poured over the top. The top is crisp and sugary.

items.name: Carrot cake
items.description: A soft, spiced cake made with grated carrot. It usually has cream cheese icing on top.

items.name: Chocolate fudge cake
items.description: A chocolate sponge cake in layers, covered in thick chocolate icing.

items.name: Croissant
items.description: A light, buttery French pastry with many thin layers. It is shaped like a half moon.

items.name: Almond croissant
items.description: A croissant filled with sweet almond paste.

items.name: Cinnamon bun or roll
items.description: A soft, sweet roll with cinnamon and sugar inside. It is often covered with icing.

items.name: Pain au chocolat
items.audioSsml: <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="pæn əʊ ˈʃɒkəlɑː">pain au chocolat</phoneme>
items.description: A flaky pastry with sticks of dark chocolate inside. It is like a croissant, but it is square.

items.name: Cornish pasty
items.description: A savoury pastry filled with beef, potato and onion. It is folded in half with a thick edge. Usually eaten hot.

items.name: Cheese and onion slice
items.description: A square of puff pastry with a cheese and onion filling. Usually eaten hot. It is savoury, not sweet.

items.name: Toasted teacake
items.description: A round, slightly sweet bread roll with dried fruit. It is cut in half, toasted and served with butter.

items.name: Sausage roll
items.description: Sausage meat wrapped in puff pastry. A savoury snack that you can eat hot or cold.
